text:
Hiro T.: Hi team, first day on Infra. Trying to get Datadog/Grafana/Sentry access but Grafana for our private VPC dashboards 404s when I'm on the corporate VPN. Email hiro.t@redwood.ai. Need dashboards: vpc-networking, vpn-tunnels, and the Sentry project infra-vpc. Also want CSV export of a traffic panel for a doc. Who do I ping?
Jules (DevEx): Welcome Hiro! :wave: Flow is Okta -> observability-vpc group for private dashboards. Two gotchas: 1) some private Grafana orgs require an internal route (bastion) instead of web VPN, 2) CSV/export depends on folder-level export flag. Start by checking Okta groups, and include your org id/region.
Hiro T.: Okta shows only default groups for me. I filed an identity request REQ-220777 per the usual flow.
okta-bot: Identity request REQ-220777 created. Manager approval required. Approve at https://idp.redwood/requests/220777
Nina (Platform): Hi @Hiro T. 44b Which org/namespace? Private VPC dashboards live under the private-orgs tenant (orgId=42). If you're on VPN but 404ing it's likely the grafana route is restricted to the VPC CIDR; I can add your user to the bastion allowlist once the Okta request is approved.
Hiro T.: Org: redwood-private-42. I accepted the VPN but still get 404 and curl to grafana.internal times out.
infra-bot: Automated: Datadog invite queued for hiro.t@redwood.ai (expires in 48h). Invite ref: 1876543210-INV. Track at https://idp.redwood/invites/1876543210
Samira (SRE): Also, for CSV exports you need grafana:export role OR the folder owner can enable panel CSV via folder settings. If you need the CSV for a doc I can pull it and drop in /shared/infra/docs.
Hiro T.: Okta request got manager approval.
okta-bot: Identity REQ-220777 status: approved. Provisioning will start.
security-bot: Reminder: For private VPC access we require company-managed device + MFA + VPN client version >= 3.2.1. Confirm device attestation at https://idp.redwood/devices.
Hiro T.: Device attested, VPN client updated. Still can't reach grafana.internal from my laptop.
Nina (Platform): I see the provisioning job failed to add your bastion user because your account lacked the private-ssh key. I've pushed a one-time jumpbox key and added you to observability-vpc. Try ssh jump.redwood.internal and then curl the grafana URL via the jumpbox: 
```bash
ssh hiro.t@jump.redwood.internal
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $GRAF_TOKEN" https://grafana.private.internal/d/vpc-networking
```
Hiro T.: SSH works and curl returns the dashboard JSON. I can view it from the jumpbox but still not from browser directly. Is that expected?
Jules (DevEx): Yes, for private orgs we often require the jumpbox or an internal proxy; browser access can be setup via an internal proxy URL but that needs infra approval. If you need desktop GUI access we can open an ephemeral proxy for your IP for 1 hour. Want me to request that?
Hiro T.: That'd be great, ephemeral proxy for 1 hour would let me export the CSV/panel.
Nina (Platform): Ephemeral proxy requested and granted for 1 hour starting 2024-10-02T14:30Z. Use the proxy URL: https://proxy.redwood/internal/hiro-t-ephemeral. Note: do not share the link externally.
Hiro T.: Proxy works, I can open the dashboard in the browser and export the CSV. Samira, could you drop the CSV to the shared drive as well?
Samira (SRE): Dropped panel CSV and a rendered PNG to /shared/infra/docs/hiro-vpc-panel.csv and panel.png. Also added the runbook link to the alert panel: https://runbooks.redwood/infra/vpc/err-rate.
Hiro T.: Datadog invite arrived and I can see vpc logs and monitors. Sentry invite pending.
infra-bot: Sentry invite sent to hiro.t@redwood.ai. Invite ref: 1876543210-SNTY
Hiro T.: Accepted Sentry and can view infra-vpc project. Everything looks good now, thanks all! :tada:
Jules (DevEx): Welcome aboard. Quick tips: 1) when working in private orgs use the jumpbox or request ephemeral proxy, 2) folder-level export flags control CSV/PNG, 3) if you need longer proxy time open a ticket referencing REQ-220777. Happy ramping!
Hiro T.: Super helpful, appreciate the quick responses. I'll DM if anything else crops up.
